name: Dodder River
text: The Dodder River, in Irish Dothra, is a small stream in County Dublin. Its headwaters rise in the Wicklow mountains. It runs about twelve miles to Dublin Bay. Two and a half miles from the city centre at Ballsbridge lies a contemporary residential neighbourhood. MacKillop marks the Dodder as the setting for the Togail Bruidne Dá Derga. The Dublin stretch of the river has long carried the literary weight of that tale.

okr.objective: The Dodder River as the Wicklow-to-Dublin stream that frames the Togail setting.
